details.publicNotes:
A war between magically advanced civilizations is ruthless and cataclysmic; the infusion of magical fallout and death energy changes and warps the environment and all creatures that manage to survive.

Fallout sparrows are birds that are forever shaped by the devastation. They travel in flocks over war zones, sustaining themselves on the magical radiation left by the conflict. Travelers or refugees fleeing war often hear these birds' tragic songs before seeing their irradiated glow. These birds sing of a battle's final moments with an eerie and discordant exactitude, imitating the whistle of bombs falling, the crash of magical detonations, or the wailing of the maimed and bereaved.

Fallout sparrow swarms fly in abrupt, unpredictable, and violently jerking murmurations, the sight of which is both unnerving and strangely captivating. Due to the way they have been warped by arcane energies, they are finely attuned to those capable of casting spells and often flock around them to feed off their magic.

When a fallout sparrow swarm is slain, it is said to leave behind a ghostly echo, which continues to sing its melancholy song.

Blast Shadows

Fallout sparrows that are themselves destroyed by a surge of magical energy often leave behind an echo of their unsettling existence. These so-called "blast shadows" might manifest as an immediate burst of psychic energy, an undead creature like a shadow, a lingering supernatural phenomenon similar to a haunt, or merely the outline of the bird's silhouette upon a nearby stone.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 45/100/180 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (piercing), armor (light), shield, perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Performance, Survival)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, charisma, constitution, death, dexterity, energy resistant (vitality), mind, mind shield, music, poison, poisonous armor, sensory (low-light vision), sturdy, wild, winged

description.value: The fallout sparrow swarm detects the magical resonance within magic items and within creatures that can cast spells.

20 feet. Fallout sparrows emit an aura of magical radiation. A creature that begins its turn in the area becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@Check[fortitude|dc:22] negates).

Trigger The fallout sparrow swarm is targeted by a spell

Effect The swarm Flies 15 feet toward the caster.

The flock of sparrows emits an eerie, discordant birdsong, mimicking the sounds of explosions, collapses, and screams. Each creature within 20 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save. On a successful save, the creature becomes temporarily immune to Devastation Mimic for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and takes @Damage[4d6[sonic]] damage.

Critical Failure The creature is frightened 2 and takes @Damage[8d6[sonic]] damage.

The fallout sparrows Fly, spraying droplets of magically radioactive poison in their wake. All creatures in and below the squares that they Fly through must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save. The swarm can't use Fallout Rain again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Fallout Rain]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d6[poison]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[12d6[poison]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.
The fallout sparrows' angry pecking deals @Damage[2d6[piercing],2d6[void]] damage to each enemy in the swarm's space (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save).
